_note: THROWAWAY seed catalog for the equipment->product affiliate-matching experiment. NOT the real catalog and NOT for display — no real brands, placeholder affiliate_urls. `affordance` is the text we embed (describes what the product is FOR, in the same 'utility register' as a recipe's needs-string). `equipment_aliases` are the deterministic-join keys (normalized equipment terms a recipe might name). Intentionally includes a few gourmet/book items to test that the matcher does NOT surface them for a pure-technique step.

products.name: Enameled Cast-Iron Dutch Oven (6 qt)
products.affordance: Heavy enameled cast-iron pot with a tight lid for braising, stews, soups, stocks, chili, and no-knead bread; retains and spreads heat evenly for long slow cooking on the stovetop or in the oven.
products.why: The one pot that sears, braises, and bakes bread — buy it once, use it for decades.

products.name: 8-inch Chef's Knife
products.affordance: All-purpose forged chef's knife for chopping, slicing, dicing, and mincing vegetables, herbs, and boneless meats; the single most-used blade in any prep.
products.why: A knife that actually holds an edge turns prep from a chore into a pleasure.

products.name: 12-inch Cast-Iron Skillet
products.affordance: Pre-seasoned cast-iron pan that gets screaming hot and holds heat for a deep sear on steaks and chops, blistered cornbread, frittatas, and shallow frying; goes stovetop to oven.
products.why: Nothing else gets a crust like screaming-hot cast iron — and it lasts a lifetime.

products.name: Fine-Mesh Strainer / Sieve
products.affordance: Fine stainless mesh sieve for straining stocks and sauces, rinsing grains, sifting flour and powdered sugar, and pressing purees smooth.
products.why: Silky sauces and lump-free batters start with a good fine sieve.

products.name: Instant-Read Digital Thermometer
products.affordance: Fast digital probe thermometer that reads doneness in a couple of seconds — for roasts, poultry, steaks, candy, deep-frying oil, bread, and custards; the end of guesswork.
products.why: The cheapest way to stop overcooking meat — cook to a number, not a hope.

products.name: Tilt-Head Stand Mixer
products.affordance: Powerful stand mixer with paddle, whisk, and dough-hook attachments for creaming butter and sugar, whipping cream and meringue, and kneading bread and pizza dough hands-free.
products.why: If you bake more than occasionally, it pays for itself in saved arms and better crumb.

products.name: Immersion (Hand) Blender
products.affordance: Stick blender that purees soups right in the pot and blitzes sauces, dressings, and mayonnaise without dirtying a countertop blender; no hot-liquid transfers.
products.why: Velvety soups without ladling scalding liquid into a blender in batches.

products.name: Food Processor (11-cup)
products.affordance: Bowl processor for fast chopping, pureeing, grating, and slicing, plus doughs, pestos, hummus, nut butters, and pie crust in seconds.
products.why: Turns 20 minutes of chopping into 20 seconds — the weeknight time machine.

products.name: Rimmed Half-Sheet Pan
products.affordance: Sturdy aluminum rimmed baking sheet for sheet-pan dinners, roasting vegetables, baking cookies, toasting nuts, and catching drips; the workhorse tray.
products.why: Buy two — half your dinners can be roasted on a single tray.

products.name: Stainless Balloon Whisk
products.affordance: Wire balloon whisk for beating eggs, whipping cream by hand, whisking vinaigrettes and sauces smooth, and folding air into batters.
products.why: A good balloon whisk emulsifies a dressing in ten seconds flat.

products.name: Fine Microplane Zester / Grater
products.affordance: Rasp-style fine grater for citrus zest, hard cheeses like Parmesan, garlic, ginger, nutmeg, and chocolate — fluffy, even shavings.
products.why: Fresh zest and finely grated Parm make a shocking difference for a tiny tool.

products.name: Carbon-Steel Wok (14-inch)
products.affordance: Flat-bottom carbon-steel wok for high-heat stir-frying, searing, steaming, and deep-frying; the sloped sides concentrate heat for wok hei.
products.why: Stir-fries taste like takeout only when the pan gets rip-roaring hot — a wok does that.

products.name: Digital Kitchen Scale
products.affordance: Precise gram/ounce scale for weighing flour and baking ingredients, portioning dough, and scaling recipes; the key to repeatable baking.
products.why: Weighing flour instead of scooping it is the single biggest baking upgrade.

products.name: Adjustable Mandoline Slicer
products.affordance: Blade mandoline for paper-thin, perfectly even slices of potatoes, cucumbers, radishes, and fennel — for gratins, chips, and salads.
products.why: Restaurant-even slices for gratins and salads — just respect the guard.

products.name: French Tapered Rolling Pin
products.affordance: Tapered hardwood rolling pin for rolling pie dough, pastry, cookies, pasta sheets, and pizza; the tapered ends give control over thickness.
products.why: A tapered pin gives you feel and control a heavy roller can't.

products.name: 9-inch Springform Pan
products.affordance: Latching springform pan with a removable side for cheesecakes, delicate layer cakes, deep-dish quiches, and molded desserts that can't be flipped out.
products.why: The only sane way to get a cheesecake out in one piece.

products.name: Single-Estate Extra-Virgin Olive Oil
products.affordance: Cold-pressed peppery extra-virgin olive oil for finishing salads, soups, grilled vegetables, and bread; an ingredient upgrade rather than a tool.
products.why: Where oil is the star — a raw drizzle, a dressing — the good bottle is worth it.

products.name: Premium Saffron Threads
products.affordance: Hand-picked saffron threads for paella, risotto Milanese, bouillabaisse, biryani, and Persian rice; a pinch delivers color and aroma no substitute matches.
products.why: Cheap saffron is a waste; a little real saffron transforms a dish.

products.name: Flaky Finishing Sea Salt
products.affordance: Pyramidal flaky sea salt for finishing — a crunchy last sprinkle on steaks, roasted vegetables, chocolate, and salads; textural, not for cooking water.
products.why: A pinch of flaky salt at the end makes food taste finished.

products.name: Classic French Home Cooking (Cookbook)
products.affordance: A foundational French home-cooking cookbook covering stocks, sauces, braises, and technique; a whole-recipe thematic companion, not a tool for any single step.
products.why: If a recipe made you curious about French technique, this is the deep dive.
